name: Arm Arcs
summary: Lying on the back with the arms reaching to the ceiling, both arms arc back overhead only as far as the ribs stay down, and return.
steps: Lie on the back, knees bent, arms straight up over the shoulders.
Breathe in to reach the arms back towards the floor behind you.
Stop when the ribs want to lift.
Breathe out to bring the arms back over the shoulders.

layers.title: Alternate
layers.text: One arm back, one arm down by the hip.

layers.title: Add the Leg Slide
layers.text: Opposite leg slides away as the arm reaches back.

cautions.note: Stay in the range that is free of pain.
Not lying flat after the first 12 weeks.

cues:
Back ribs stay heavy on the mat.
Shoulders slide away from the ears as the arms go back.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
